First, note the date format: 09-06-1424 is likely DD-MM-YYYY (since months don’t go to 1424).  
So: Day = 09, Month = 06, Year = 1424.  

Subtract 6 months: 06 - 6 = month 00 → month 12 of previous year.  
So: 09-12-1423.  

Now subtract 1 day: 09 - 1 = 08.  
So: 08-12-1423.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1423-12-08
